name: Western Blot – Day 2
description: Day 2 of Western blotting: wash membrane, secondary antibody incubation, washing, ECL detection, and imaging. Continue from Day 1 overnight primary antibody incubation.
source_note: General educational template for Western blot detection and imaging.

steps.title: Wash membrane after primary antibody
steps.description: Remove primary antibody solution (save for reuse if desired). Wash membrane 3 times with TBST (or PBST) on a rocker. Each wash: 5–10 min.
steps.notes: Three washes × 10 min each. Thorough washing reduces background signal.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.description: Dilute HRP-conjugated secondary antibody in blocking buffer (5% milk or 5% BSA/TBST). Incubate membrane on rocker at room temperature.

reagents.name: 5% milk or BSA in TBST blocking buffer

steps.notes: Secondary antibody must match the species of the primary antibody host (e.g., anti-rabbit secondary for rabbit primary antibody).

steps.title: Wash membrane after secondary antibody
steps.description: Remove secondary antibody. Wash membrane 3–4 times with TBST. Each wash: 5–10 min. The more thorough the washing, the lower the background.
steps.notes: Add 1 wash with TBS (without Tween) at the end to help remove detergent.

steps.title: ECL substrate detection
steps.description: Mix ECL reagents A and B (equal volumes). Remove excess TBST from membrane (blot edge). Apply ECL mixture evenly to membrane. Incubate briefly per kit instructions (30 s to 5 min).

reagents.name: ECL detection reagent (Luminol/Peroxide, e.g., SuperSignal, Clarity, Amersham)

equipment: Chemiluminescence imaging system or X-ray film + darkroom
steps.notes: Incubation time with ECL depends on antibody affinity and protein expression level. Start with minimum time and increase if signal is weak.
steps.warnings: Protect from light once ECL is added.

steps.title: Image membrane
steps.description: Image using a chemiluminescence imager (ChemiDoc, Azure, G:BOX, etc.) or X-ray film exposure. Capture multiple exposures (short and long) to accommodate different signal intensities.
equipment: Chemiluminescence imaging system or X-ray film/cassette
steps.notes: Save raw images. Adjust exposure to avoid saturation. Both pre-stained ladder and bands of interest should be visible.

steps.title: Strip membrane for re-probing (optional)
steps.description: If re-probing with a different antibody is needed, strip the membrane using a commercial stripping buffer or mild stripping solution. Wash thoroughly afterwards and re-block before applying new primary antibody.

reagents.name: Stripping buffer (e.g., Restore, Mild Stripping Buffer)

steps.notes: After stripping: wash 2× TBST 5 min, then re-block and probe with new antibody. Multiple rounds of stripping may reduce signal.
steps.warnings: Some stripping buffers contain β-mercaptoethanol or SDS. Work in fume hood if applicable.

steps.title: Store or process membrane
steps.description: If not stripping, store membrane in TBST at 4°C short-term, or allow to dry between filter paper for longer storage. Record band positions relative to ladder for molecular weight determination.
steps.notes: Annotate and archive images with date, antibody details, and exposure times.
